Great app for translating long passages in many languaged. I’ve used Speak and Translate
 for almost 10 years for English to Spanish, French and Swahili. It works very well. It is always a good idea with translation apps to run something the opposite as well, (f.e. Spanish back to English) to make sure that the app is not translating something too literally, but this app generally gets what I’m trying to say first time. One complaint that I have, is that if I use the app extensively(which I do when I’m traveling) the app slows down and takes a long time to boot up (often several minutes). When that happens, I find that deleting and reinstalling the app fixes it and it boots up quickly again. Aside from that, this is a great app and I highly recommend it.

I am canceling. The app works well. It translates exactly what’s said, but it does not have punctuation. For the language I use the app for, if there’s a pause or the voice is inflected at the end, it’s a signal that there should be punctuation. Without the punctuation, the entire meaning of what’s said is different. Because of this, I need a new app. I’m paying for this one and that seemingly minor issue is a very large problem. Even the free app I use puts punctuation. I don’t know why this one won’t. And, to make it worse, I am asked to do a review every time I use the app. I am typically using the app in the midst of a conversation. This becomes a problem when trying to communicate with others. I won’t be renewing.
